inspections.sourceIdentity: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation)

inspections.sourceIdentity: FIPS 203, Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard
inspections.locator: §1 Introduction — ML-KEM and its three parameter sets (ML-KEM-512, -768, -1024).
